prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop website concept, 1600x1000 landscape, flat front-facing screenshot with no browser chrome and no device frame
Primary request: Create compositional option three for COVENANT, a serious financial protocol website in a "Security Print Instrument" direction. This is a new composition inspired by the supplied approved reference, not an edit or copy.
Scene/backdrop: full-bleed warm ivory security-paper field with a precise midnight navy outer keyline, restrained guilloche engraving, microline textures, serial ink, and a modern institutional finish.
Subject: A dossier-led landing page. A narrow left editorial column contains the wordmark "COVENANT", a concise navigation row, the headline "Credit follows proof.", a short description of a "10 CTC facility", and a "PUBLIC EVIDENCE" action. The dominant right side contains one large integrated proof instrument, not a group of cards.
Composition/framing: 1600x1000 flat desktop layout. Left editorial column uses roughly 30 percent width with strong whitespace and serious editorial hierarchy. Right proof instrument uses roughly 70 percent width. Inside the proof instrument, a vertical cobalt security thread runs through and visibly connects six sequential proof events from top to bottom: "5 USDC PAID", "ATTESTCOIN PROOF", "CREDITCOIN VERIFICATION", "COVENANTSATISFIED", "4 CTC DRAWN", and "REPLAY REJECTED". Use engraved dividers, evidence stamps, serial notation, and a restrained oxblood proof seal. The bottom full-width band contains independently inspectable evidence links formatted as serial-number ledger entries, for example "E-0417 PAYMENT RECEIPT", "A-1842 ATTESTATION", "C-0032 CREDITCOIN TX", "V-0082 COVENANT EVENT", and "R-0001 REPLAY CHECK".
Style/medium: polished web UI concept rendered as modern security printing, crisp two-dimensional layout, serious modern financial typography, high information clarity, subtle engraved linework, no photorealistic paper mockup.
Color palette: warm ivory, midnight navy, strong cobalt, restrained oxblood, small mint verification accents.
Text (verbatim): "COVENANT"; "Protocol"; "Evidence"; "Risk"; "Docs"; "Credit follows proof."; "10 CTC FACILITY"; "PUBLIC EVIDENCE"; "5 USDC PAID"; "ATTESTCOIN PROOF"; "CREDITCOIN VERIFICATION"; "COVENANTSATISFIED"; "4 CTC DRAWN"; "REPLAY REJECTED"; "E-0417 PAYMENT RECEIPT"; "A-1842 ATTESTATION"; "C-0032 CREDITCOIN TX"; "V-0082 COVENANT EVENT"; "R-0001 REPLAY CHECK"; "PUBLIC · VERIFIED".
Constraints: dossier-led composition, one large right-side proof instrument, vertical security thread clearly connects all six events, lower evidence band reads as independently inspectable serial-number entries, crisp legible typography, balanced white space, flat website screenshot, no device frame, no browser frame, no watermark.
Avoid: card grid, dashboard tiles, vintage overload, coins, charts, graphs, neon, gradients, glassmorphism, 3D mockup, photographic shadows, ornamental clutter, crypto token icons, people.
